basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old mechanical engineering student from São Paulo, Brazil, with a newfound passion for surfskating. I discovered Reddit while searching for tips and communities related to surfskating and board sports. I love exploring new hobbies, especially those that involve the outdoors, and I dream of owning a YOW board. I'm usually online during evenings and weekends, juggling studies and part-time work as a barista. Currently single, I enjoy spending time at the beach and connecting with like-minded enthusiasts online. I'm still getting the hang of Reddit's dynamics, but I'm excited to learn more.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge primarily stems from my engineering studies, which have given me a basic understanding of mechanics and materials. I have also learned a lot about surfskating through online communities and YouTube tutorials. I'm not an expert yet, but I'm eager to learn and participate in discussions about board sports.
